_comment: Intentional npm deprecation notices for historical package names. Do not unpublish; route consumers to canonical replacements.

deprecations.name: @holoscript/parser
deprecations.message: Deprecated: parser is merged into @holoscript/core. Use @holoscript/core parser exports instead.

deprecations.name: @holoscript/compiler
deprecations.message: Deprecated: compiler implementations live in @holoscript/core and user commands live in @holoscript/cli.

deprecations.name: @holoscript/traits
deprecations.message: Deprecated: traits are merged into @holoscript/core. Use @holoscript/core trait exports instead.

deprecations.name: @holoscript/agent-sdk
